meta.description: Registry for symbolic stability conditions for NavT under transport-path perturbation in Phase 3.

symbolic_stability_conditions.statement: The transport neighborhood remains locally admissible before and after perturbation.
The perturbed transport path remains within declared local_process_state_equivalence tolerance.
Transport perturbation does not introduce undefined intermediate states.
Residue and orientation drift remain bounded within declared transport stability conditions.
Transport closure retention remains conditionally bounded under perturbation.
Identity-preserving local transport mappings remain equivalent under local_process_state_equivalence.
